data.title: Telling Time to Five Minutes

challenges.instruction: Set the clock hands to show 4:05.
challenges.hint: Remember that the minute hand points to the first small tick after the 12 for 5 minutes.
Count by fives around the clock face: 5, 10, 15, 20. Where should the minute hand point?

challenges.instruction: Can you set the clock to show 10:35?
challenges.hint: The minute hand points to the 7, which represents 35 minutes past the hour.

challenges.instruction: Set the clock hands to show 2:50.
challenges.hint: At 50 minutes, the hour hand is almost all the way to the next hour, and the minute hand points to the 10.
The minute hand points to the 3 for a quarter-past time, which is 15 minutes.

data.description: Practice setting analog clock hands accurately to five-minute intervals, building strong foundational time-reading skills.
